payload.title: Broker: start, poll and the private approval operations
payload.description: Owner: Cyclotron session. broker/handler.py, transactions.py, throttle.py and infra/broker.yaml per docs/design.md: POST /start and /poll on the function URL (per-caller rate limits, slow_down); describe, bind (once, sha256(N)), complete (checks N, stores the code) and deny only by IAM invoke; DynamoDB with TTL; the code handed out exactly once by conditional delete; every answer carries the protocol version; no token ever held. Gherkin: replayed, expired, denied, substituted, double-bound and concurrent-poll transactions yield nothing.
